description: This file defines a React component named 'EditSmartViewModal' that provides a modal dialog for editing properties of a 'Smart View', including title, icon, and predicate JSON. It manages user interactions, state, and communicates with an associated controller for saving or deleting views.

methods.name: saveSmartView
methods.description: Handles saving the smart view, performing validation on the title and invoking the save method from the controller.

methods.name: toggleIconPicker
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the icon picker popover.
